title: Tequila Sunrise- Walk to Broadway, Pool & Gym
description:
Welcome to TEQUILA SUNRISE at The Hyve in Downtown Nashville!

Our 6th floor Tequila Sunrise-themed 2-bedroom condo is nestled in the heart of The Gulch neighborhood in Nashville. Step into a world where every corner is infused with the warm and lively spirit of a Tequila Sunrise cocktail. As you enter the space, you are greeted by a burst of color, reminiscent of a stunning sunrise over the horizon. Enjoy a patio, heated pool, gym, onsite parking, and walking to Broadway- just .7 miles away!

The space
Are you looking for a place to stay in Nashville that checks all the boxes?

- Walking distance to Broadway and major attractions
- Insta-worthy decor throughout the entire unit
- Brand new building
- Has an outdoor pool with cabanas & sunbathing area
- Outdoor courtyard with gas grill & ping pong table
- State-of-the-art gym with Peloton equipment
- Balcony with a prime pool view
- Full-sized washer and dryer in the unit
- Self check-in/check-out

Look no further, you have found it!

Welcome to Tequila Sunrise, the ultimate vacation rental that truly checks all the boxes! Nestled in the heart of one of Nashville's trendiest neighborhoods, The Gulch, this vibrant and stylish condo offers everything you need for an unforgettable stay. Walk to Broadway, indulge in the city’s best attractions, and enjoy luxury amenities in a brand-new building. Celebrate your bride-to-be in style! Our space is perfect for a memorable bachelorette weekend in Nashville, complete with chic vibes and close proximity to all the fun!

The living room is a cozy haven adorned with warm hues of orange, pink, and yellow. Relax here or make use of the two queen-sized murphy beds for additional sleeping space. The bedrooms are thoughtfully designed for both comfort and style. The master bedroom boasts a luxurious queen-over-king custom bunk bed with plush bedding, while the second bedroom features two sets of twin-over-twin bunks.

The fully equipped kitchen is perfect for preparing meals or crafting cocktails, and the private balcony provides stunning views of The Gulch. Sip your drink as you soak in the vibrant energy of Music City—it’s the perfect way to unwind after exploring Nashville.

WALKABLE TO ALL THE FUN!
- City Winery
- Bad Axe Throwing
- Third Man Records & The Blue Room
- Party Bus & Pedal Tavern pick ups
- Yee-Haw Brewery
- Ole Smoky Distillery
- Tennessee Brew Works
- Music City Center (conv center)
- Country Music Hall of Fame
- Bridgestone Arena
- Upper Broadway (Tootsies, The Stage, Assembly Food Hall, and more!)
- Lower Broadway (Hard Rock, Jason Aldean’s, Luke Bryan’s, Kid Rock’s, Ole Red, and much more!)
- Ryman Auditorium

SHORT UBER RIDE TO: 
- Nissan Stadium
- Grand Ole Opry
- Opry Mills Outlet Mall

If you are parking a car during your stay, you will have 3 options:
- Owner/Guest Garage - this is a FREE first come, first serve garage that requires the Latch app for access. You will receive Latch access upon booking.
- Street Parking - this is FREE first come, first serve parallel street parking
- Lower Level Garage - this is a paid public parking garage that has direct elevator access right to your condo floor. Discounted pricing is available for people staying at one of our condos.

GUEST ACCESS:
- Entire unit (except owner’s supply closet)
- Outdoor pool w/cabanas (Heated Pool! Open from March-Oct 7a-10p)
- Courtyard with fire pits
- Outdoor gas grill and kitchen area
- Ping Pong table outside by pool deck
- State-of-the-art gym featuring Peloton equipment
- Community Lounge

AMENITIES:
- Keurig coffee maker and k-cups
- Grill utensils
- Shampoo, conditioner and body wash
- Hairdryer
- Iron/ironing board
- Pool bag and pool towels
- Ping pong paddles and balls
- Walk-in closet with extra bedding
- Washer & dryer, detergent included
- Games & books
- On-site security

PLEASE NOTE: 
- All common areas and amenities like the pool, cabanas, gym, lounge, lobby, etc. are managed by the building. We do not have control over the working conditions of equipment, maintenance, or availability.
- This is a condo located in downtown Nashville. As pictured, this development sits near train tracks. We have provided a white noise machine and ear plugs for your convenience. Like any urban location, the presence of unhoused individuals may be experienced.
- Arriving ahead of check in time? The Hyve offers complimentary luggage storage! Please check with us for hours.

If you have any questions at all about this property, please reach out to us. We would love the opportunity to host you and share a bit of our city with you!

Presented by Injoy Nashville: Experience Your Stay, Design by NP/Injoy
